name: QA exploration agent with log-derived tests

mentions.name: QA exploration agent with log-derived tests
mentions.description: A QA-testing workflow in which an AI agent explores a web app as a tester and logs its explorations to a file; automated tests are derived from that log, so tests run frequently and cheaply while the agent runs only occasionally.
mentions.problem: Agent-based QA exploration took several minutes per run, making frequent runs expensive.
mentions.source_excerpt: QA exploration: I was using an agent to explore a web app as a QA tester. It took several minutes per run. After some iterations, the more practical path was having it log its explorations to a file, then derive automated tests from that log. The agent still runs occasionally, but the tests run frequently and cheaply.
